Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. And 3 Others

Hon'ble Siddharth,J.
Heard Sri Kartikey Singh.

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: learned counsel for the applicant; Sri Ramanuj Tripathi, learned counsel for the informant; learned AGA for the State and perused the material placed on record.

The instant bail application has been filed on behalf of the applicant, Pintu, with a prayer to release him on bail in Case Crime No. 398 of 2020, under Sections 376, 506 IPC and  POCSO Act, Police Station Naujheel, District- Mathura, during pendency of trial.

entities.text: Pintu vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicant submits that it is a case of false implication of the applicant.
The applicant is related as Mausa of the child victim.
He has been falsely implicated in this case case.
The father of the victim has taken Rs.30,000/- from the applicant, but was not returning the same.
When the demand was pressed by the applicant, the FIR was lodged by informant through his minor daughter.
Learned counsel for the informant and learned AGA have vehemently opposed the prayer for bail of the applicant.
After hearing the rival contentions, this Court finds that the incident took place on 01.10.2020 and the FIR was lodged on 12.10.2020.
The medico legal examination of the victim was conducted on 13.10.2020.
The victim has made clear allegations against the applicant regarding commission of the alleged offence after giving her some medicines.
She has claimed her age as 13 years.
From the certificate of the principal of the school also, she appears to be aged about 13 years only.
There is no inconsistency in her statements under Sections 161 Cr.P.C. and 164 Cr.P.C.
The applicant being close relative had committed the heinous offence against the victim.
It is not a fit case for enlarging the applicant on bail at this stage.
The bail application is accordingly rejected.

The court below is directed to conclude the trial against the applicant, as expeditiously as possible,
preferably within a period of one year from the date of production of certified copy of this order.
Order Date :- 21.2.2023 Ruchi Agrahari  Pintu vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 21 February, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/119962427/
